title: automate-changelog-and-onboard-aurora-pro-13b-v1.4-perf-metadata-changelog-automation
author: Maya Chen
description: Onboard aurora-pro-13b v1.4 with updated performance profiles and metadata, and extend changelog automation so new model uploads automatically generate release notes entries. Motivation: v1.4 includes tokenizer fixes, KV-cache layout tweaks, and a new quantization-friendly checkpoint that impacts throughput/latency characteristics. This PR adds model metadata (schema+manifest), perf profiles for p3/p4/a10g and multi-GPU split, unit/integration tests for the new profiles, docs snippet, and an enhancement to the changelog generator to ingest model metadata and auto-create draft release notes in CHANGELOG.md. Also includes a small fix to the perf harness parsing logic that prevented some throughput measurements from being recorded. Related Linear: ENG-3421, ENG-3490. This description lists the intent, scope, and what reviewers should verify (metadata schema correctness, perf numbers sanity, changelog output).
commits: Add aurora-pro-13b v1.4 metadata manifest and model card
Add perf profiles: aurora-pro-13b-v1.4-p3.yaml, p4.yaml, a10g-multi.yaml
Update changelog-generator to parse model manifests and emit release notes entries
Fix perf-harness parser for multi-benchmark runs
Add unit tests and CI fixtures for new profiles
review_conversation: Daniel Park: Please include latency p50/p95 and throughput numbers for each profile and hardware target. The p3 numbers look optimistic; can you attach raw benchmark outputs?
Maya Chen: Added raw benchmark fixture and updated p3/p4 profiles; numbers are from perf-harness run 2026-02-12 (attached in ci/fixtures).
Sofia Martinez: The changelog generator change looks good overall; please ensure template includes quantization/compatibility notes. Also request small wording changes in the model card.
Maya Chen: Incorporated wording changes and added a template field for quantization_support (yes|no|partial).
Arjun Rao: Noted a flake in tests on a10g multi-GPU CI; turned up an edge-case in the perf-harness parser. I pushed a small fix and re-ran CI.
CI: model-registry workflow passed after rerun.
release_notes:
- Onboard aurora-pro-13b v1.4: tokenizer fixes, KV-cache layout improvement, quantization-friendly checkpoint.
- Added perf profiles for p3/p4/a10g and multi-GPU split with validated p50/p95/throughput numbers.
- Changelog generator now auto-creates model release note drafts from model manifests.
- Fix: perf-harness parser for multi-benchmark runs.
